bio: John H. Bucy III is a native Texan and small business owner serving District 136 in the Texas House of Representatives. First elected in 2018, John represents part of Williamson County, including Northwest Austin, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Round Rock, and the Brushy Creek area. John was named Vice Chair of the House Committee on Elections and Vice Chair of the Subcommittee on Disease Prevention and Women’s and Children’s Health for the 89th Legislative Session. He was also appointed to the House Committee on Public Health and House Committee on Local and Consent Calendars.
